cause: The v1.8.6 release closeout edited only the notes header when tagging, leaving lines 79 and 96 still claiming the release was never pushed, merged or tagged; BACKLOG had never been rolled past the v1.8.0/v1.8.1 era and omitted v1.8.6 entirely.
impact: A published release document contradicted the actual repository state (origin/main = tag v1.8.6 = 9d5e947), and the single live rolling ledger omitted an entire shipped version.
lesson: Release closeout must update every statement about release state, not only the header. A document treated as authoritative in one section is trusted in all of them, so a stale process disclaimer reads as fact.
